annotations.text:
A · Today first
Groups habits by time of day and shows only what is due today. Things / Amie territory.

Works — the screen you open every day is the lightest one here, and checking off is a single pass.
Costs — weekly and monthly rhythm is not on this screen, so it leans on the Stats tab.

B · Grid
The weekly check grid, kept but cleaned up. HabitKit / GitHub-contributions territory, and the closest to the app as it stands.

Works — a habit you are behind on is obvious, and editing past days stays easy.
Costs — gets crowded past roughly ten habits.

C · Compact
Dark-first, tight rows, a coach card and a quick-add bar. Linear / Superhuman territory.

Works — the AI coach and sync status this fork already has finally live inside the app instead of only in notifications.
Costs — much weaker once it moves to a light theme.

D · Journal
Editorial and serif-led (Newsreader). Bear / Craft territory.

Works — least like every other habit app, with none of the gamified feel.
Costs — low information density, and the 'write a line about today' field is a feature the app does not have yet.

E · Rings
Colour-coded tiles with ring progress. Streaks / fitness-app territory. The colours come straight from the app's current palette.

Works — large tap targets, and colour makes habits fast to tell apart.
Costs — falls apart past roughly six habit colours.
